protocol.study: Independent retrospective Ethereum eight-week screening replication
protocol.status: Frozen before training or test prediction inspection
protocol.positive: Address in the pinned author phishing-label list and represented in the phishing transaction tables
protocol.negative: Root EOA represented in normal transaction tables, excluding the complete phishing-label list
protocol.comparison_sampling: Keep normal roots with integer(first eight hex digits of address) modulo 20 equal to zero; retain all represented labeled phishing roots. Fixed address-hash sampling is independent of observed features and model scores.
protocol.two_week_bins: Bin 1 starts at each wallet's first observed transaction; bin 4 ends strictly before first timestamp plus 56 days. The observation end, not last activity, is the horizon cutoff.
protocol.embargo: At least 56 days between each fitting cohort's final first appearance and the following cohort's first appearance
protocol.features: Exactly eight activity and twelve counterparty variables as in the revised Bitcoin experiment. Ethereum edges are direct transfers, not Bitcoin input-output projections. No amounts, absolute timestamps, identifiers, supplied embeddings or label-based graph features are predictors.
protocol.deduplication: Each address, transaction hash and direction appears at most once across source tables. Contract creation with a missing endpoint is omitted and counted.
protocol.model_settings: Use the existing locked Bitcoin learner settings without external test-selected tuning. Train Ethereum models only on Ethereum training wallets; preprocessing fits only training inputs. Neural checkpoint selection uses full-view validation AP. Each full/prefix F1 threshold is chosen only on its own validation scores.
primary_metrics: precision among top ceil(0.01 N) wallets
protocol.uncertainty: Report every seed, arithmetic means and sample SD; 500 paired address-bootstrap AP differences per model using seed 2026. This sampling interval does not capture dependence among addresses.
protocol.acceptance: No test-driven hyperparameter, split, feature, class orientation or seed selection. Save test and validation scores and fitted artifacts. Independently recompute metrics and thresholds. Report negative results as well as improvements.
protocol.limitations: The external corpus was sampled retrospectively and its released histories are bounded. First appearance means first observed in this corpus, not verified address creation. The author label list is retrospective, with no historical label-release time. Negative accounts are sampled unlabeled EOAs, not adjudicated licit cases. These results are conditional on released-corpus selection; they are not prospective operational validation or a proof of no selection bias. This local protocol freeze is not registered preregistration.

test_prediction_inspection: None in this corpus before this freeze
